## Verification

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and affected documentation is current.
- [ ] Relevant behavior and failure paths are covered, or the verification limits are explained above.
- [ ] Tests and reproductions use isolated homes, projects, and catalogs, not real provider configuration.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private context, identifying logs, or incidental generated artifacts.
- [ ] Applicable mutation paths preserve plan/apply, path safety, backups, and separate trust, executable, and private-context approvals.
